The structure of composition K2Mg(AsO3)2 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a 14-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while K adopts a 12-coordinate close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors; As is three-coordinate to O. Corner-sharing between Mg octahedra and face-sharing between K and Mg polyhedra are observed, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
